reason: Weak-stemmed plants have stems too weak to hold themselves up. The quality belongs to the stem (PO_0009047), not the whole plant: decreased strength, which has the exact synonym 'weak'.
Bosselé means covered with rounded bumps (bosses). PATO knobbled is the surface-feature shape with many rounded projections. FLOPO:0991060 tuberculate is a close second choice.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum between two values: oblong PATO_0000946 – oblanceolate PATO_0002330)
reason: A compound of two outline shapes that both exist in PATO, like 'linear-lanceolate'. The broken spelling and 'oblongoblanceolate' are scanning errors for the same compound.
A daisy-like head is a capitulum with ray flowers around a disc, which is the definition of radiate. Apply it to the head (inflorescence) even where the flora says 'flower'.
Pliant leaves, needles and phyllaries bend without breaking: PATO flexible. It is the opposite of 'rigid', which maps to inflexible.
Hoodlike means cucullate (FLOPO:0991119 has 'hooded' and 'hood-shaped' as exact synonyms). This is its negation, as with 'unlobed'.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum between corymb-like PATO_0002455 and raceme-like FLOPO:0991197)
reason: An inflorescence between a raceme and a corymb, like 'umbellate-racemose', which the value table says must not become a lexical rule. Both values already exist.

label: holomycotrophic
definition: A trophic quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its obtaining all of its carbon and nutrients from mycorrhizal fungi throughout its life, lacking functional photosynthesis.
reason: A real and diagnostic way of feeding (orchids, Burmanniaceae, Triuridaceae) with no term in PATO or FLOPO. Like epiphytic, it is probably outside PATO's scope, so keep it in FLOPO.
'Sub-' means 'nearly', as in 'suborbicular'. This is acuminate held as an approximate value, not a new quality.

label: semi-ellipsoid
definition: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like half of an ellipsoid cut along its long axis: flat on one face and convex on the other, with an elliptic outline.
reason: Used for pyrenes, seeds and halves of pods. It sits beside PATO:0005000 hemispheroid, which covers only half a sphere. FLOPO:0991184 plano-convex says nothing of the elliptic outline.

target: new: conjunction of two values on one bearer (caudate PATO_0001880 with the tail subulate PATO_0001954)
reason: Both values hold at once (a bract ending in an awl-shaped tail), so this is not a continuum. Both terms exist in PATO.

target: docs/odp/09-relation-to-another-part.md (alternate placement PATO_0001932 towards petal PO_0009032)
reason: A position stated relative to another part: stamens or staminodes inserted between the petals. It uses the relation pattern with the petal as the other part.
'Nervation pennée' / 'pennate nerves' means one midrib with secondary veins on both sides, which is pinnately veined.

label: self-incompatible
definition: An incompatible quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its functional pollen being unable to fertilize the ovules of the same plant or of genetically identical plants.
reason: A standard breeding-system character in Onagraceae treatments and elsewhere. PATO has only the generic incompatible, which serves as the parent.

label: tristylous
definition: A heterostylous quality inhering in a flower or plant by virtue of its belonging to a species whose flowers occur in three morphs with long, mid-length and short styles, the anthers standing at the two heights not occupied by the stigma.
reason: A specific, well-defined form of heterostyly (Lythrum, Oxalis, Pontederiaceae). It is narrower than FLOPO:0991137, which serves as the parent.
Not a quality word. It is a length measurement whose bearer is the hairs on the organ, so the trichome is the bearer and the numbers go to the measurement pattern.
PATO falciform has 'hooked', 'uncinate' and 'unciform' as synonyms, which covers hooklike staminodes, tendrils and endocarp projections.
Same rule as 'veined' (C211). 'Many' is not a number, so the count pattern does not take it ('few'/'many' are held as measurement_value_not_numeric).

target: docs/odp/03-count-of-parts.md (5 leaflets PO_0020049; with digitate PATO_0001980 where stated)
reason: Quinate leaves have five leaflets: a count of parts like '5-foliolate'. The digitate arrangement already has a PATO term.
Epapillose = without papillae, the negation of FLOPO papillose. It is common for moss leaf cells.

label: transversely dehiscent
definition: A dehiscent quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's opening at maturity along a line or slit at right angles to its long axis.
reason: Covers fruits and anthers that open by a transverse slit. FLOPO:0991150 circumscissile is a narrower case (the slit runs all round and a lid falls away) and should become its child.
'Non accrescent' calyx or perianth is the negation of FLOPO accrescent. The source spelling 'acrescent' is a typo.
The French feminine form of bosselé: a fruit or seed surface with rounded bumps. Same rule as 'bosselated'.

target: new: conjunction of two values on one bearer (apex obtuse PATO_0001935 and mucronulate FLOPO:0991055)
reason: A rounded apex ending in a small point: both values hold together, so this is not a continuum. Neither part needs a new term.

label: strangling
definition: A positional quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its starting life as an epiphyte and sending roots to the ground that grow round and enclose the trunk of its host.
reason: A distinct way of growing (Ficus, Clusia) in tropical floras, between epiphytic and terrestrial. It is not covered by FLOPO epiphytic or climbing.
Netlike veins, sheaths and pit surfaces form a network: FLOPO reticulate. PATO:0001947 netted is a colour pattern and is not right here.
PATO platelike (exact synonym 'plate-like') = roundish and flattish, which fits plate-shaped cupules. Check corollas 'en forme de plateau' against FLOPO:0991144 salverform.
Long-rhomboidal moss leaf cells are elongate rhombs. As with 'depressed-globose', the compound maps to one shape term; 'long' is a degree within rhomboid.

target: fibril (no PO class; needs a FLOPO anatomy class for the helical wall thickening of Sphagnum hyaline cells) absent
reason: States that Sphagnum hyaline cells have no wall fibrils. PATO:0002134 fibrillary means nanoscale fibres and is the wrong sense. The part has no class yet.

Deep-seated rhizomes, stolons and stems lie well below the soil surface. FLOPO subterranean is the position; the depth is a degree that has no term. PATO increased depth is a dimension of the part itself.
